runtime_provenance_amendment.what_changed: TASK-20260914-861bb9's PINNED IMAGE IDENTITY constraint (base_oci_image must be exactly sagemath/sagemath@sha256:2401ffa8e9fc85c7ea17d3649bde5958b4dbf0858b3e504098c4102720151711) is explicitly amended, scoped to this successor lock only. The runtime this lock describes is NOT derived from any OCI image: it is SageMath 10.9 installed from the conda-forge channel via micromamba directly on a host container filesystem (added to the crypto-autoresearcher workspace in PR #1186, merged to main before TASK-20260914-861bb9 executed), per runtime-provision-report-20260914-861bb9.json's alternate_runtime_actually_available_here block.
runtime_provenance_amendment.why_this_is_not_a_scientific_protocol_am: experiments/EXP-FROB-d8aa37/specification-stage0-v2.yaml's own frozen runtime_requirements block (read directly by this coordinator) never names an OCI image, Modal, or Docker: it requires required_os Linux, sage_version 10.9, maximum_workers 1, memory_mb 8192, and the two required_guards text items (process groups + 8192MiB RLIMIT_AS; single worker; preserved aggregate-memory protections). image_digest, sage_executable_sha256 and python_executable_sha256 are declared null there, to be filled once a runtime exists. The specific OCI digest was an admission-layer choice made when the original linux-runtime-lock.json was cut, and was elevated to a hard PINNED IMAGE IDENTITY gate by TASK-20260914-861bb9's own handoff text. Amending that admission-layer choice therefore does not edit, does not weaken, and does not require reopening specification-stage0-v2.yaml, whose file is untouched by this record.
runtime_provenance_amendment.why_accepted: Every guard the frozen specification actually names is measured and passing on this runtime: required_os Linux (confirmed), sage_version exactly 10.9 (confirmed), a real POSIX process group (confirmed, pgid 926 == pid of the setsid() child), per-process RLIMIT_AS exactly [8589934592, 8589934592] (confirmed), single worker (policy, unchanged by runtime choice), in-process libsingular with no external Singular/pexpect (a property of the frozen driver.py/checker.py sources, unaffected by which Sage 10.9 build runs them), and all four frozen source hashes plus the specification hash and the plan hash match the frozen values exactly (confirmed by source_check below). The pinned-image route is categorically unreachable in this runtime class -- the sandbox policy refuses to start a Docker daemon at all, classified and blocked as a containment-escape action rather than a transient failure -- so requiring the exact pinned digest here is not 'wait and retry', it is indefinite.
runtime_provenance_amendment.what_this_amendment_does_NOT_resolve: This amendment accepts the divergence in runtime PROVENANCE/IDENTITY only. It does not by itself discharge dependencies.json.runtime_lock_requirements item 1's aggregate-memory-protections component (see aggregate_memory_guard below), and it does not resolve a second, independently found gap in this same runtime's probe coverage (see python_bundled_with_sage_not_independently_corroborated below). scientific_launch_authorized is false in this lock for those two reasons -- not because the provenance amendment was refused.
